findings.claim: A smooth differential equation is one realization: the update relation is represented by a differentiable flow only in a declared local chart.
findings.failure_mode: The current formal/finite artifacts do not establish a differentiable flow or ODE realization. In formal/lean/OC133V12.lean, SmoothSystem.flow is only Nat -> State -> State, SmoothChart.derivative and localLaw are uninterpreted fields, and the finite checks only compare chart flags and flow_one_target/smooth_step_target tokens. This is a hidden smoothness/ODE overclaim relative to the ledger statement that no differentiability or ODE-solution theorem is promoted.
findings.required_repair: Reword this as chart-labelled flow-one update notation with an explicit no-differentiability/no-ODE-support boundary, or add real formal obligations for continuous-time flow, differentiability, local law binding, and ODE solution semantics with matching finite/formal evidence before using differential-equation or differentiable-flow language.

findings.claim: T133-HYBRID: proof/rewrite and guard/reset updates remain first-class non-smooth cases.
findings.failure_mode: The integrated guard/reset semantics only covers the firing guard branch. operatorAdmitted for OperatorRoute.guardResetHybrid requires guardObserved=true, guard_reset_binding_obligations then forces h.guard xh=true and hybridStep h xh=h.reset xh, and integrated_operator_semantics returns only that reset branch. Although hybrid_no_guard_uses_update exists, it is not admitted in the integrated route. proofs/FINITE_MODEL_CHECKS_1_3_3.json has only guard=true hybrid_guard_reset cases, so the no-guard update branch of a hybrid system is not covered by the promoted claim.
findings.required_repair: Either narrow T133-HYBRID to the fired guard/reset branch only, or extend OperatorAdmission/operatorAdmitted and integrated_operator_semantics to admit and prove both guard=true reset and guard=false step branches with typed source/target and derivative rejection; add finite positive and negative cases with guard=false and actual_next=step_target.
